content:
Randy Rainbow didn’t let Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) cruise through her final weeks on Capitol Hill without a punchline.

In a new video posted Tuesday, the song satirist spanked usual target Donald Trump in a parody of Cole Porter’s “You’re the Top” from “Anything Goes.”

But he roped in Boebert for a dirty one-liner at the president in a tweaked version titled “He’s a Flop.”

“He’s a flop, he’s the lowest-rated. He’s a flop, he’s the schmo most hated,” Rainbow sings.

A bit later, he croons, “He’s a flop, and girl he’s a loser, he’s a Boebert hand job, oooohhhhh!”

Boebert eventually lost her reelection bid to Democrat Eileen Laubacher, and perhaps her most embarrassing moment as a politician might follow her around for a bit.

That was the night at a performance of the “Beetlejuice” musical where she appeared to grope her date and got escorted out.

At least Rainbow didn’t devote a whole bit to Boebert handjobs like Desi Lydic of “The Daily Show” did.
